speaker: Judith
line: Oh great keeper of knowledge, I beseech thee for more tales of thine escipades across the stars!

speaker: Cabrera
line: Quiet down. The *good* children are trying to study.

speaker: Judith
line: Such as statement implies I, too, am a good child, for I seek to study the knowledge of thy brain.

speaker: Cabrera
line: Are you going to be specific or will you be play-acting for the forseeable future?

speaker: Judith
line: Fine. I want to know about how dangerous it is out in the cosmos. I've heard tales of star-eating monsters and space pirates.

speaker: Cabrera
line: The monsters are called Cavum. Every so often, one appears at the edge of the galaxy and begins to consume all the stars it can.

speaker: Cabrera
line: They are unfathomably large. Incomprehensible of origin.

speaker: Cabrera
line: They're hard to describe, but from the pictures I saw, I'd say they look like giant animal carcasses--they move through the expanse of space like a body floating through a river. Their limbs are broken and twisted. Dark bodies covered in little blinking lights--as if the light of the stars they consume is trying to break free from its prison.

speaker: Cabrera
line: Imagine the way that a deep sea fish's teeth emerge from the gloom and snap up prey. That is how the planet of Tiradine felt when this massive *thing* appeared from nothing and ate their star.

speaker: Cabrera
line: The planet was lost without a sun to sustain it. The people had to flee to the stars.

speaker: Cabrera
line: It's the malcontents and desperates from Tiradine who make up the majority of space pirates. Many of them are desperate for supplies they can no longer get from their doomed home. Others just want to hunt and destroy for glory and fortune.

speaker: Cabrera
line: Thankfully, Lydia and I had the funds to take a safe route through the stars.

speaker: Judith
line: Yeah. Lydia would've made hell for the pirates though. She never goes down without a fight.

speaker: Cabrera
line: That's a humerously naive statement to make, but yes, I know she'd fight as best she could...
